item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get Application Catalog

request.description:
Retrieve application catalog details based on the specified application type. 
This helps identify supported application types and their available features.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get Logout Status

request.description: Retrieve the logout status of user accounts associated with the specified identity provider (Identity Provider). This is useful for tracking the outcome of account logout actions in batch operations.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Trigger Account Logout

request.description: Initiate a logout request for user accounts associated with the specified identity provider (Identity Provider). This action helps enforce session termination for compliance or security purposes.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get Identity Provider Feature State

request.description: Retrieve the current status and last scan timestamp of a specific feature enabled for the identity provider (Identity Provider). This helps assess feature health and scan recency.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get Identity Provider Account Count

request.description: Return the number of user accounts linked to the specified identity provider (Identity Provider). Filtering options can be applied to count specific types of accounts such as orphaned or privileged users.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Generate Identity Provider Account CSV Report

request.description: Generate a CSV report of accounts associated with the specified identity provider (Identity Provider). The report supports compliance audits and user access reviews.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get Multi-factor Authentication Activity Count

request.description: Return the number of multi-factor authentication (Multi-factor authentication) activities recorded for the specified identity provider (Identity Provider). This count helps evaluate authentication volume and usage patterns.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get Multi-factor Authentication Activity Count by App Type

request.description: Return the number of multi-factor authentication (Multi-factor authentication) activities for the specified identity provider (Identity Provider), grouped by application type. This helps analyze authentication trends across different SaaS applications.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Generate Identity Provider Multi-factor Authentication Activity CSV Report

request.description: Generate a comma-separated values (CSV) report of multi-factor authentication (Multi-factor authentication) activities for the specified identity provider (Identity Provider). This report helps audit authentication patterns and policy compliance.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get Multi-factor Authentication Activity Logs

request.description: Retrieve a list of multi-factor authentication (Multi-factor authentication) activities for the specified identity provider (Identity Provider). The logs include user identities, timestamps, IP Address addresses, and Multi-factor authentication methods used.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get All Identity Providers

request.description: Retrieve a list of identity providers (Identity Providers) configured for the tenant. You can optionally filter the results to view only designated identity providers.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Create Identity Provider

request.description: Create a new identity provider (Identity Provider) entry for the tenant. You can specify the type, identifier, and whether it should be marked as designated.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get SaaS Account Count

request.description:
Return the number of user accounts associated with the specified software as a service (SaaS) instance. 
You can apply filters to refine the account count based on criteria such as roles, status, or account types.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Generate SaaS Account CSV Report

request.description:
Generate a CSV report of accounts linked to the specified software as a service (SaaS) instance. 
This report helps in auditing user presence and roles within the application.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get SaaS Account List

request.description:
Retrieve a list of user accounts associated with the specified software as a service (SaaS) instance. 
The response includes account metadata such as roles, login activity, and status for each user.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get SaaS Activity Logs

request.description:
Retrieve a list of activity logs for the specified software as a service (SaaS) instance. 
Logs include user actions, accessed resources, locations, and timestamps to support security auditing and monitoring.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get SaaS Instance List

request.description:
Retrieve a list of software as a service (SaaS) instances configured for the tenant. 
Each instance includes metadata such as application type and display name.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get Ticket Issues

request.description:
Retrieve a list of issues linked to a specific ticket for the given software as a service (SaaS) instance. 
This helps in tracking and managing remediation or investigation items.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Get SaaS Instance Tickets

request.description: Retrieve a list of tickets associated with the specified software as a service (SaaS) instance. Tickets track security findings, misconfigurations, or other remediation needs.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Create SaaS Instance Ticket

request.description:
Create a new ticket for the specified software as a service (SaaS) instance. 
Tickets help track remediation efforts for flagged issues or vulnerabilities.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Delete SaaS Instance Tickets

request.description:
Delete or unlink one or more tickets associated with the specified software as a service (SaaS) instance. 
This action is typically used to close resolved or invalid issues.
